sum: TWFG, Inc. operates an independent distribution platform for personal and commercial insurance products in the United States. The company offers auto, home, renters, life, health, motorcycle, umbrella, boat, recreational vehicle, flood, wind, event, luxury item, general liability, property, business auto, workers' compensation, business owner policy, and professional liability insurance products, as well as commercial bonds and group benefits. TWFG, Inc. was founded in 2001 and is based in The Woodlands, Texas.
ceo: Mr. Richard Finley Bunch III (Chairman & CEO)
